info.title: SKU.io — Sync your SOPs with SKU.io changes
info.description: Keep internal SOPs in step with SKU.io: compare your SOP content against SKU.io's changelog and docs since your last review, and rewrite the stale steps or draft a new SOP in your format. Use when internal docs or SOPs may be out of date, or on a schedule to catch drift.

get.summary: Confirm the SKU.io connection and identify the tenant (via tenant_id) so SOPs can be grounded in the customer's real setup (their warehouses, custom fields, pricing tiers). Requires no scopes. Do not use /api/auth/profile: it is session-only and returns 403 "This endpoint is not available to API tokens." for every PAT. OPTIONAL — reading the public documentation and changelog (docs.sku.io) needs no token; only account-specific grounding does.
